note:
There is a lake in the park, but the campground is not lakefront.  --AWH
Quartzite (sites 1-100, a former golf course) is open and grassy and takes the largest rigs; Northern Lights (104-246) has the only wooded electric sites; Ice Age (301-535) is non-electric and mostly tents. Showers, water taps and dump stations shut from about mid-October to mid-April. --Claude
summary: DNR camping and property pages, the Quartzite/Northern Lights map and imagery read. 423 family sites (146 electric: Quartzite 75, Northern Lights 71) and facilities confirmed; no laundry. Not waterfront agrees with --AWH ('Campsites are not within sight of the lake'). Season (manual) still matches. Fees, amperage and site lengths not on any page read; GoingToCamp not retried. Pin is on the north-shore visitor center; suggested move to Quartzite.
